verdict.rationale: Context.dev's core outputs (Markdown, JSON, HTML, screenshots) are inherently open formats returned via API, so scraped/crawled data is never locked into a proprietary format, and there's no subscription lock-in since it's a pay-per-call API. However, there is no explicit account-level 'export all my data and close account' feature, no bulk export of stored history/configurations, and no documentation addressing full data portability beyond per-request outputs. missing for 10: explicit account-wide data export tooling, evidence of stored data (job history, monitors, API keys) being exportable, and any documented account-closure/data-portability workflow.
